payload.title: [native-swift-6] join() media-plane token (CallMediaGrant.token) is broadcast to every events-stream observer, n...
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING native-swift-6 (low/isolation, confidence=medium, verify-votes +1/-1)

FILE: packages/swift/Sources/FrickSwift/FrickSyncSocket.swift
LINES: 1569-1578

WHAT: `handleCallCommandResult` resumes the awaiting `callCommand` caller AND additionally yields the full `FrickCallCommandResult` (including `mediaGrant.token`, a short-lived participant-scoped media credential) onto the shared `events` stream for all observers. Combined with finding native-swift-1, any code iterating the socket's events (other stores, logging/telemetry sinks, app observers) receives the join media token even though only the caller needs it. It is same-process and short-lived, but it is a credential placed on a broadcast surface where it can be inadvertently logged.

IMPACT: Increased exposure of a media-session bearer token within the process (e.g. if an events observer logs unrecognized events). Not a cross-tenant leak.

SUGGESTED FIX: Either omit `mediaGrant` from the broadcast `.callCommandResult` event (deliver it only via the awaited return value) or document that observers must treat it as sensitive and never log it.
